findings.issue: only one of the 19.5.1.4 p2 localizing contexts had a discriminating plan; the others did not make the wrong (host) resolution observable
findings.resolution: every localizing-context plan states its own wrong-resolution observable (distinct sentinel value, KIND or result) and cites the shared companion local-object-declaration-hides-host; per-context companions judged unnecessary (narrowed)

findings.issue: construct-association plans for SELECT TYPE/RANK were one-way, and expression selectors lacked a value plan and a non-definability owner
findings.resolution: two-way associate/selector plans for ASSOCIATE, SELECT TYPE and SELECT RANK; expression selectors associate with the value (p3), with a value plan and cross-references to the existing Clause 11 owners
